reasoning: Provider record 15459aa5-b297-4e33-9624-c9d59b75ba46 (stock_mergers, event date 2022-02-14) names acquirer AMD (CUSIP 007903107) and acquiree XLNX (CUSIP 983919101); it is identical in both data_quality payloads. The primary SEC filing (URL, retrieval time and SHA-256 in evidence) states: "(the "Company") completed the previously announced combination with Advanced Micro Devices, Inc." and "As a result of the consummation of the Merger on February 14, 2022, at the Effective Time a change in control of the Company occurred and the Company became a wholly owned subsidiary of AMD.". The filing therefore documents that Xilinx, Inc. became a wholly owned subsidiary of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. on 2022-02-14, consistent with the provider record placing AMD as the acquiring issuer of this merger record. Decision SAME_ENTITY: the record belongs to the Stage R entity AMD (as acquirer). Economic neutrality was not used as identity evidence. Under v2.0.3 item 5 the record is then processed as the entity's frozen §3.4 review item (acquirer-side merger).
